analysis.description: The interior space features a minimalist bedroom with a blend of Indian design elements. The large built-in wardrobe is constructed from white marble panels with a glossy finish, framed by dark wood, reflecting urban Indian design trends. A sheer curtain in white fabric, hung on a copper rod, adds a cultural touch and complements the overall aesthetic. The space is well-lit with natural light from a window and demonstrates efficient use of space with built-in storage solutions, combining traditional materials like wood with modern finishes like marble.

metadata.budget_indicator: Moderate to High, given the use of marble and wood
